Questions about AI face analysis

Is the AI face analyzer free?

+

Yes. The full analysis runs in your browser at no cost, with no login, no sign-up and no subscription. You only pay if you choose the optional Face Blueprint report, unlocked through a one-time $7.99 credit pack with no recurring charges.

What can an AI face analyzer measure?

+

Our AI face analyzer maps your visible facial landmarks from a photo to describe your face shape, facial symmetry, golden ratio proportions, and eye or jaw features. It strictly measures geometry and cannot measure personality, health, intelligence, or universal beauty.

Is my face photo stored?

+

Your privacy is our priority. The AI face analysis runs entirely in your browser. A temporary copy stays in your current browser session so you can explore other face rating tools, but your photo is never uploaded to our servers unless you actively choose to save a report.

What photo should I use?

+

For the most accurate face analysis, use one clear, front-facing photo in even light. Keep the camera near eye level, avoid a very close wide-angle selfie, and make sure hair, hands, or glasses do not cover your important facial features.

Why can my face rating change between photos?

+

Camera distance, lens distortion, head angle, expression, and lighting all change your visible facial proportions. You haven't changed, but the image geometry has. We show a photo-quality note so you understand exactly how reliable your face rating is.

How is this different from other face rating apps?

+

Most apps give you one score and keep the measurements hidden. We show every measurement that produced your result — face shape, symmetry, proportions, jaw and eye geometry — so you can see exactly what the camera captured and what it didn't.

How accurate is the face analysis?

+

Accuracy depends on your photo quality, landmark coverage, and the specific facial feature. We publish our repeatability tests, known failure cases, and AI model limitations instead of presenting one unsupported accuracy percentage.

See your face with more clarity.

Upload one clear photo to start your free, private AI face analysis and discover your true facial proportions today.

Analyze My Face

关于AI人脸分析的问题

AI人脸分析仪是免费的吗？

+

是的。 完整的分析在您的浏览器中免费运行，无需登录、无需注册、无需订阅。 您只需选择可选的面部蓝图报告即可付费，该报告通过一次性 7.99 美元信用包解锁，无需经常性费用。

AI人脸分析仪可以测量什么？

+

我们的人工智能面部分析仪会从照片中映射您可见的面部特征，以描述您的脸型、面部对称性、黄金比例以及眼睛或下巴特征。 它严格测量几何形状，无法测量个性、健康、智力或普遍的美。

我的脸部照片是否已存储？

+

您的隐私是我们的首要任务。 人工智能人脸分析完全在您的浏览器中运行。 临时副本会保留在您当前的浏览器会话中，以便您可以探索其他面部评级工具，但除非您主动选择保存报告，否则您的照片永远不会上传到我们的服务器。

我应该使用什么照片？

+

为了获得最准确的面部分析，请在光线均匀的情况下使用一张清晰的正面照片。 将相机保持在眼睛附近，避免近距离广角自拍，并确保头发、手或眼镜不会遮挡您重要的面部特征。

为什么我的脸部评分在照片之间会发生变化？

+

相机距离、镜头畸变、头部角度、表情和灯光都会改变您可见的面部比例。 你没有改变，但图像的几何形状改变了。 我们会显示照片质量的注释，以便您准确了解您的面部评级的可靠性。

这与其他面部评级应用程序有何不同？

+

大多数应用程序都会给你一个分数，并隐藏测量值。 我们会显示产生结果的每一项测量结果——脸型、对称性、比例、下巴和眼睛的几何形状——这样您就可以准确地看到相机捕捉到的内容和没有捕捉到的内容。

人脸分析的准确度如何？

+

准确性取决于您的照片质量、地标覆盖范围和特定的面部特征。 我们发布了可重复性测试、已知故障案例和 AI 模型限制，而不是提供一个不受支持的准确率百分比。
